TOOL 1 build-viability REBUILT. ctx.dispositions is now built the way Engine.seedDispositions() builds it (raw record disposition; unseeded id -> gate.js num(undefined)=0). The derived-ceiling walk is DEMOTED to record.counterfactual_race_gate, labelled COUNTERFACTUAL, and never produces a criterion verdict.

NEW MODEL: quest npc_disposition consequences (machine.js:424) are counted as a real in-play route, as a player-optimal UPPER BOUND (seed + every positive gift from every quest except the target and its mutual exclusives). A gate this bound cannot clear is a gate no play can clear.

RESULT on this tree: 0/540 viable, 540 NOT VIABLE (FAIL, not unmeasurable), exit 1. 9 quests carry a giver disposition bar no play can reach: Q-ARCH-01/dyer-sallis 0/30, Q-SOUL-02/undertaker-vaskh 0/40, Q-BLAK-01/prefect-hallow 0/20, Q-STRM-01/quartermaster-sedd 0/25, Q-LILM-01/harbourmistress-tesh 16/45, Q-SAP-01/cutter-neeth 0/40, Q-LEDG-01/factor-belliene 0/35, Q-DOCK-01/npc-porter-eeja 0/30, Q-DEEP-01/speaker-teel-ashaan 0/50. THE RECORD-LESS GIVERS ARE NOW A BUILD FAIL, not corpus debt.

WHY THE FAIL IS AIRTIGHT: for 8 of the 9 the ONLY positive npc_disposition consequence is authored on the quest the giver themself gates (circular). harbourmistress-tesh gets +8 from Q-MAG-01 and +8 from Q-MAG-20, total 16, against a required 45. And __HARNESS.npcDisposition() answers 'nobody by that name is in the world' for all nine in the RUNNING build, so Charm (sim/magic/apply.js:880) cannot reach them either.
RED, on the running engine (independent of the self-test): __HARNESS.questOffers() reports exactly nine `X disposition 0/N` clauses, one per record-less giver, matching the tool's list id for id.

GREEN, on the running engine: shadow tree (scratchpad/shadow/game) with the nine records minted at disposition 60 -> questOffers() reports ZERO disposition clauses; the tool at --data-root on the same tree reports 540/540 viable, 0 unpassable gates.

RED AGAIN on a working tree: shadow2 lowers speaker-teel-ashaan 60 -> 10. Engine: 'speaker-teel-ashaan disposition 10/50'. Tool: 1 unpassable gate, 0/540 viable. Tool and engine agree in all three states.
build-viability --self-test 18/18, including an explicit RED check, an explicit GREEN check (seed_disposition fixture), and an N-1-blocks/N-opens bar check so the FAIL is not a constant.
--signatures is now READ: 'all', a race id (walks 54 cells), or a count; an unrecognised value is a usage error. It was advertised and inert for two rounds.

*** BLOCKER, NOT MINE, LANDED MID-PASS: game/src/engine.js (uncommitted, M) grew Engine._assertGiversAreVisibleToRace() at line 4686, which THROWS in _boot: '19 quest givers with no NPC record, 13 with a record and no reaction_group'. __HARNESS.ready() rejects, so EVERY browser-based tool in the tree exits 12 and boot-check FAILS. *** THE TREE MOVED UNDER THIS PASS AND IT CHANGED THE ANSWER. Another agent landed (a) game/data/npcs/quest-givers.json with 19 minted records + reaction_group on 37 mainline records, and (b) Engine._questDispositionModel() installed on QuestEngine.dispositionModel, with QuestEngine.context().dispositions = dispositionView() running every giver through _dispositionToward() -> derivedDisposition(). THE QUEST-OFFER PATH IS NOW RACE-SENSITIVE. Round 2's model (raw seed) and round 3's first model were both correct for the tree at the moment they were written and both became wrong hours later.

CONSEQUENCE FOR THE TOOL: build-viability now DETECTS which offer model the build implements, from three NAMED SOURCE ANCHORS (engine.js `this.questEngine.dispositionModel =`; machine.js `_dispositionToward` consulting `this.dispositionModel`; machine.js `dispositions: this.dispositionView()`), reports the anchors it matched, and REFUSES (exit 20) when the halves disagree — a half-wired race term is the state this corpus has twice been misled by. --offer-model raw|derived forces either.

AND --cross-check: boots the game and compares the static walk's per-giver numbers against the running build's questOffers()/explainDisposition(). Result on the current tree: AGREES, 0 disagreements, model 'derived', engine refused 0 givers. This is how a tool RI-MTH06 requires to be static stays true to the world.

build-viability --self-test 20/20 on the current tree. The RED is now an INJECTED defect (unseed_givers fixture reproduces the record-less state) rather than a description of one afternoon's data, so it keeps working after the data is fixed: no_unpassable_gate FAIL 0 -> 540, givers stopping at least one signature 0 -> 3, 0 unmeasurable. Monotone seed ladder 0->540, 15->270, 30->36, 45->0, 60->0, 100->0 fail proves the NUMBER is read, not the presence of a record.

TOOL 5 cadence REBUILT. (a) NOTHING satisfies C1 by name any more: every non-locomotion action must be corroborated by one of C1's five world facts within 60 frames. The round-2 FLAG_TOGGLE free pass is gone. Added FLAG_FIELDS - a change in player.locked_on/stance/guard_raised/weapon_id/attuned/state or ui.menu_open between records IS clause 3 observed. (b) C7 traversal_fraction is measured from player.speed_mps / player.pos displacement, with teleports (>30 m/s) excluded and reported. (c) LATENT BUG FOUND AND FIXED: round 2 read `r.frame`, and every shipped trace numbers frames `f` - so on every real trace every frame index was 0 and every gap was computed against a constant. Both keys accepted; no key at all -> unmeasurable.

cadence RED+GREEN: the critic's own sweep re-run - all twelve shipped actions (roll, menu, lock_on, spell_cycle, light, block, interact, crouch, two_hand, swap_right, sprint, jump) mashed for an hour in an empty room now give C1 FAIL / gap 3600 s / traversal_fraction 1.0 (round 2 gave four of them PASS / 0.17 s / 0). Same `f` vs `frame` bug fixed here: round 2's window filter used r.frame, so every encounter window was empty on every real trace.

NULL CONTROL: stick at rest, same 120 frames, rAF loop LIVE, drift 0.00 m.

gamepad-shim RED: new --break-router installs a second init script that zeroes the axes where the engine's router reads them while gamepadPoll() keeps reporting a perfect [0,-1,0,0] observation. Result: page sees the pad, mapping preserved, poll axes change - ALL EIGHT round-2 checks stay green - and the player moves 0.00 m. That is exactly TOOL-COVERAGE-R2 §7's 'a pad that moves nothing passes 8/8'. --self-test 12/12. notes_for_successor: THE TREE MOVES UNDER YOU.
